config.notes: Lincoln University (NZ). Course pages are www.lincoln.ac.nz/study/study-programmes/programme-search/<slug>/ (server-rendered, no page JSON). Key-facts panel under the H1: "Upcoming start dates Semester 1 - 22 Feb 2027 Semester 2 - 19 Jul 2027 [or November Summer School - 09 Nov 2026] Qualification <level> Duration <n> years full-time Credits <n> Location <campus> Fee estimate 2027 Domestic: $x (N credits) International: $y (N credits)". The bracketed credits are the load the amount covers: fee is read only when quoted per 120 credits (one full-time year, NZD). Amounts quoted for 60, 180 or 240 credits (certificates, 1.5- and 2-year taught masters) are partial-year or whole-programme totals and are deliberately not read. Term mapping Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July is from the course pages themselves ("Semester 1 (late February) Semester 2 (early July)"). IELTS is not on course pages (they link to the central English language requirements page). No course code printed on pages.
